description: Sets how many lifetime visits Sergio assumes an average customer stays for (assumed_lead_visits, 1 to 200), as the Lead value setting does, turning a lead's per-visit comparable price into an estimated lifetime value. A later change can put it back. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: set_lead_value
title: Set the lead-value assumption
